term.name: decoding_error_rule
term.definition: What the one decoder of UTF-8, UTF-16, ISO-8859-1 and US-ASCII octets does with octets that do not decode: fail (the XML parser; text decoding without fallback), or replace each maximal subpart by one U+FFFD and go on (text decoding with fallback; the HTML input stream) (sxml_xml_decoder; Unicode 16.0, 3.9.6; )
